name: Shut the Door Behind You
Vox Populi
en:
The name of the achievement is Latin for \"(The) voice of the people\". Can be combined with the ''Shut the Door Behind You'' achievement

}

=== Patch 1.5 (CotS) ===

- id=\"Banana Republic\"

name: Banana Republic
en:
Note that while {{iconify|Sugar Plantation|building||link}}s are a part of the United Fruit Company, they do not count towards the 75 required building levels necessary for the achievement. A combination of Sugar Plantations and {{iconify|Banana Plantation|building}}s may, however, be used to get the company to 100 prosperity.

- id=\"Deșteaptă-te, Române!\"

name: Deșteaptă-te, Române!
en:
Note that player needs to control required states in their entirety, split states do not count towards the achievement. The name of the achievement is Romanian for \"Awaken Thee, Romanian!\", and is the name of the national anthem of Romania and former national anthem of Moldova.
Of the three independent Romanian countries ({{flag|Transylvania}}, {{flag|Wallachia}} and {{flag|Moldavia}}), Wallachia is the easiest, as they and Moldova have [[Romania#Journal_formation|journal entries]] to annex each other, and of those two, Wallachia is the biggest and most powerful. Releasing {{flag|Romania}} from a bigger nation (such as {{flag|Austria}}) after controlling all nine states is allowed. - id=\"Devil's Railroad\"

name: Devil's Railroad
en:
* For Guyana, try conquering/colonizing states with British/French presence (but held by another nation) and using \"Trade States\". Because completing the JE require at least 10 rubber plantations in every state, you will need to control British Guyana and either French or Dutch Guyana.
* {{flag|Brazil}} is the most obvious country, but any country can complete this achievement. If playing as another country, it is recommended to liberate {{flag|Amazonia}} from Brazil and then later annex them, since they are unrecognized and thus cost less infamy.

- id=\"Estado Novo\"

name: Estado Novo
Federation Day
en:
* Start as Bolivia and immediately go to war with Brazil while they are already at war with the minors and you probably can get a good chunk of land (if great powers don't intervene; note that Bolivia starts with 50 infamy).
* Alternatively, declare war to liberate nations from Brazil. Maybe go for them a second time later to weaken them, so they won't intervene in your future expansion. After that, it should be easy. Can be combined with \"Viva la Confederación\" and \"Devil's Railroad\"
{{icon|cotsb|w=36px}}

- id=\"Magnanimous\"

name: Magnanimous
en:
* The easiest and fastest way for the achievement is to abdicate after Isabel has been confirmed as heir and is 18 years old. Start the enactment of a law which greatly angers the Intelligentsia to get their opinion to {{red|−10}}.
* It is recommended to pass {{law|Slavery Banned}} '''before''' Pedro takes the throne, as doing so does not reduce the progress bar.
{{icon|cotsb|w=36px}}

- id=\"Not Yet Lost\"

name: Not Yet Lost
en:
{{collapse list|The name of the achievement is a reference to the current national anthem of Poland: \"Poland is not yet lost\" (\"Jeszcze Polska nie zginęła\").|** To activate Expanding the Commonwealth Journal Entry, one needs to research Pan-Nationalism. Completing it requires one to fully own Minsk, Kyiv, and a few other states. However, if you already own the states before activating the JE, the JE will be skipped thus locking you out of the achievement.}}

- id=\"Piratini, not Pira-tiny\"

name: Piratini, not Pira-tiny
en:
[[Grão-Pará]] starts with higher GDP, higher population and a bigger army than [[Piratini]]. Their starting general is also arguably better suited for the initial defensive war. Piratini does however have a better literacy (23.5% vs 13.4%).

- id=\"Republic or Death!\"

name: Republic or Death!
en:
* Activating the [[South_America_content#Si_Vis_Pacem,_Fac_Bellum|''Si Vis Pacem, Fac Bellum'']] Journal Entry requires that you do '''not''' continue Francia's legacy in the [[South_America_content#A_Meeting_in_Asunción|''Meeting at Asunción'']] event.
* Forming {{flag|Rio de la Plata}} blocks this achievement.
{{icon|cotsb|w=36px}}

- id=\"SPQR\"

name: SPQR
Stonks
en: - id=\"Viva la Confederación!\"

name: Viva la Confederación!
en:
To get this achievement you can probably do nothing until you form the confederation as long as legitimacy is above the threshold, however researching {{technology|Nationalism}} does block you from obtaining the achievement, due to the Bolivian identity journal entry starting and blocking Peru-Bolivian confederation.

}

- id=\"Bootlicker\"

name: Bootlicker
en:
Starting as {{flag|Parma}}, form a defensive pact with {{flag|Austria}}, then start a diplomatic play against {{flag|Lucca}} for investment rights. Sway Austria to your side by offering to become their subject, then ask for regime support. This should bring the Pro-Austrian lobby to max appeasement.
For 1.13, it's easier starting with {{flag|Hungary}} with their pro  {{flag|Austria}} lobby. At the start it has appeasement at +2, improving relations to cordial is another +2, investment rights +4 and regime support +4.

- id=\"Can't Touch This\"

name: Can't Touch This
en:
{{collapse list|{{flag|Cuba}}, the {{flag|East India|British East India Company}}, and the {{flag|East Indies|Dutch East Indies}} meet the foreign ownership of GDP requirement at the start of the game.|
* Starting as {{flag|Cuba}}, achieve independence from Spain – preventing them from further investing in your economy, and enact Command Economy to enable nationalization without compensation. Make sure that your overlord holds all the provinces that invested in your country when you start nationalizing or you can get a NULL_STATE ownership which won't allow you to nationalize some of the buildings, and you will be unable to fulfill the requirements
** '''It should be noted that the investment pool is actually disabled if you have no construction sectors, allowing you to nationalize every building easily without having to wait for command economy, as well as not having to worry about non-nationalized buildings being built by the investment pool.'''
** This opens up the door to getting the achievement much faster by utilizing releasable nations. For example, as {{flag|Denmark}}, you can build and privatize a whaling station on Iceland. Once the building is successfully sold, release and play as {{flag|Iceland}}. You can subsequently nationalize the whaling station, and from then on just need to wait 12 years for the achievement.}}

- id=\"Cult of Reason\"

name: Cult of Reason
Declaration of Independence
en:
* The {{flag|Ottoman Empire|Ottoman}} subjects automatically go free if the Ottomans fail the Tanzimat.
* {{iconify|Hanover|image=Flag HAN subject GBR.png|4=link}} is almost guaranteed to become independent shortly after the game starts.

- id=\"Diplomatic Victory\"

name: Diplomatic Victory
en:
You can simply conquer other great powers, the achievement will trigger once you're the only great power.

- id=\"Durran Durran\"

name: Durran Durran
For Twelve Years You Have Been Asking
en:
Starting as {{flag|Bahrain}}. Delete your Port and do nothing for 12 years.

- id=\"Great Game no re\"

name: Great Game no re
Iranzamin
Hermit Kingdom
Honor and Life
Hyperpeace
en:
* Easiest to do as {{flag|Russia}}; be sure to strike while Qing is still suffering from opium addiction.
* Can be completed as either Finland or Korea as well

- id=\"I'm the Captain Now\"

name: I'm the Captain Now
en:
{{Collapse list|* Starting a power struggle requires at least 20% more prestige than the leader; winning requires maintaining at least 15% more prestige for 12 months.|
* Starting as a large German minor in {{flag|Prussia}}'s power bloc, such as {{flag|Bavaria}} or {{flag|Saxony}}, annex the other German minors and industrialize until your prestige exceeds Prussia's. Best done on a non-Ironman game, as you could lose all progress if the leader kicks you out of the bloc.

* {{flag|Two Sicilies}} is also one viable option which starts off in {{flag|Austria}}n power bloc. Keep a good relationship with the leader while you unify {{flag|Italy}}. Aim to finish researching quinine by the time you form Italy which should be relatively easy with Austria helping spread research. Once you form the nation and become a great power, rush through all the expeditions and your prestige will suffice for a power struggle. Reading Campaign and all Italy achievements can be combined into this run.

* Another confirmed approach to this achievement is to start as {{flag|Russia}} and release {{flag|Ukraine}} as a nation and continue as Ukraine. This weakens Russia significantly while Ukraine has the potential to grow fast, gain independence from Russia (if Ukraine was released as subject), then (re-)join the power bloc and take over leadership.}}

- id=\"Standard Oil\"

name: Standard Oil
en:
* This is very easy to accomplish in virtually any playthrough, but inevitably requires you to wait until the oil tech is unlocked more globally. Easiest to do as a Great Power and then just puppeting a nation that will eventually have oil, like [[Venezuela]].
* Although it doesn't require {{icon|soib|w=24px}} Sphere of Influence, without the DLC, only subjects can be invested in.

- id=\"The New Order\"

name: The New Order
en:
Unlocking four principle slots requires at least ten members and rank 3 or better for the power bloc
{{icon|soib|w=36px}}

}
